text: This horse could do math. Or could he? In Berlin, Clever Hans answered sums by tapping his hoof. Two plus three? He tapped five times. Crowds were amazed. Experts were stumped. Then a psychologist hid the answer. If Hans could not see the questioner, he failed. Hans was reading people’s faces. When the answer came, people relaxed without knowing. Hans stopped tapping. Is your pet a genius, or just reading you?
